errors.text_span: This image presents a donut chart
errors.evidence: The reference description identifies this as a pie chart, not a donut chart. A donut chart has a hole in the center, which is a significant structural difference.

errors.text_span: a title which is prominently displayed in bold black text within the center hole of the chart
errors.evidence: The reference description does not mention any title displayed in the center of the chart. Since this is described as a pie chart (not a donut), there is no center hole, and no such title is mentioned.

errors.text_span: None of the percentage labels are located inside the colored segments
errors.evidence: The reference description states that labels are 'inside or beside the slices,' implying some labels may be inside the slices, contrary to the machine description's claim that none are inside.

errors.text_span: when moving counter-clockwise from the right side of the chart
errors.evidence: The reference description does not mention the direction of arrangement or starting position of segments. This directional detail is not verifiable from the reference.
